verses.text: This is also what Yahweh says:
When I came to you to rescue you,
I cause the sky to become dark,
Yahweh our God has given me his wise message [MTY]
Yahweh our God has spoken to me [IDM],
I allowed people to beat me on my back
But, because the Lord our God helps me,
God, the one who vindicates me, is near to me;
The Lord our God defends me in court,
But you people who oppose me,
